result.stdout:
Usage: nildiff <oldFolder> <newFolder> [reportLabel] [options]

Arguments:
  <oldFolder>    Absolute path to the baseline (old) folder.
  <newFolder>    Absolute path to the comparison (new) folder.
  [reportLabel]  Optional label used as the subfolder name under the active reports root.
                 Default root is the user-local app-data Reports/ folder, or --output if specified.
                 When omitted, a high-resolution timestamp label is auto-generated.

Options:
  --help, -h                  Show this help message and exit.
  --version                   Show the public SemVer version and exit.
  --banner                    Show the ASCII-art banner and exit.
  --no-banner                 Suppress the startup banner during normal diff runs.
  --doctor                    Print build/commit diagnostics and probe IL disassembler availability.
  --print-config              Diagnostic: print env+supported CLI overrides as indented JSON without semantic validation.
  --validate-config           Validate config.json + env overrides before runtime CLI overrides (0=valid, 3=invalid).
  --no-pause                  Skip key-wait at process end.
  --config <path>             Path to config.json (default: user-local app-data config.json;
                              falls back to bundled config.json when absent).
  --threads <N>               Override MaxParallelism (0 = auto).
  --no-il-cache               Disable the IL cache for this run.
  --clear-cache               Interactive wizard to selectively delete IL cache files.
  --skip-il                   Skip IL comparison for .NET assemblies.
  --no-timestamp-warnings     Suppress timestamp-regression warnings.
  --creator                   Apply the default maintainer IL normalization profile.
  --creator-il-ignore-profile <name>
                              Apply a maintainer-managed IL normalization profile.
  --wizard                    Interactive mode: prompts for old/new folders and an optional report label.
                              Shows exist
[truncated]
